It restates textbook RATTLE properties (solvability under nonsingular GG^T, exact constraint projection by construction, symmetric second order) for one prescribed parameter point (unit masses/lengths, g=9.81, H0 slice [-12,-8], rate box <=2, cutoff h<=0.005) plus a trivially non-invariant frozen-multiplier strawman.
